meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Use when committing changes to git or naming branches. Triggers include "commit", "커밋", "git commit", "finalize changes", "save to git", "commit my work", "branch name", "브랜치 이름", "what should I name this branch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成规范的git提交信息和分支名称
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要统一git提交规范
copy.tagline_en: Generate standard git commit messages and branch names
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need consistent git commit conventions

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求提交代码或命名分支时，Claude 会分析文件变更，按照项目规范生成韩语提交信息（标题≤50字、以名词形结尾），并确保一次提交只包含一个逻辑变更。也会根据你的描述生成符合格式的分支名。
howto.when: 当你说“提交代码”、“保存到 git”、“保存工作”、“给分支起名”，或提到 “commit”、“커밋”、“save to git”、“branch name” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交这次代码变更。
say.note: Claude 会分析改动并生成规范的提交信息。
会根据类型和描述生成分支名。

say.text: 检查一下我该提交哪些文件。
say.note: Claude 会分析变更并建议如何拆分提交。

howto.what_en: When installed, upon request to commit or name a branch, Claude will analyze file changes and generate a Korean commit message following project conventions (title ≤50 chars, noun-ending). It ensures atomic commits and produces branch names per rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "commit", "커밋", "git commit", "save to git", "save my work", "branch name", "what should I name this branch", or similar requests to commit or name branches.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze changes and generate a compliant commit message.
Claude will generate a branch name per convention.

say_en.text: Check which files I should commit.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest commit splitting.
